title: DiGiorno Starlink Chess
description: A surreal scene shows a robed figure extending a hand to move a glowing blue orb chess piece on a fiery chessboard. In the background, a cracked stone archway displays a 'STARLINK' sign above a large DiGiorno pizza logo with the text 'It's not delivery. It's DiGiorno.'
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a wizard in a blue and purple robe reaching to move a glowing blue orb on an elaborate chessboard with ornate silver and glowing pieces. Pink peonies in silver vases sit on the board as flames and purple energy swirl around. In the background, an ancient cracked stone archway bears a glowing 'STARLINK' sign above a large DiGiorno pizza with the text 'It's not delivery. It's DiGiorno.' Dramatic sunset sky with purple neon light arc.
